_comment: Staging fragment for ONE car-seat option (Batch E). Filename equals the option id in src/data/seed.json. Do NOT edit seed.json — the integration pass folds this in. See ../../RESEARCH_PLAN.md.
name: Cybex Cloud G Lux

verifiedAttributes._comment: Facts to fold into the option's attributes. carrierLb/fitsWayfinder/fitsAlterrain/safety map into seed.json; the rest is audit trail.
verifiedAttributes.safety: Ergonomic lie-flat recline + extended leg rest; Linear Side-impact Protection (L.S.P.); anti-rebound load-leg base (reduces crash forces up to ~30%); SensorSafe smart chest clip
verifiedAttributes.bobWayfinderAdapter: none for Cloud G — BOB's Wayfinder Cybex fitment names the Aton series and Cloud Q only; the Cloud G/Cloud G Lux is NOT listed (Strolleria + bobgear adapter finder)
verifiedAttributes.bobAlterrainAdapter: none for Cloud G — BOB Alterrain / Alterrain Pro list names 'Cybex Aton and Cloud Q series' only; Cloud G is NOT listed
verifiedAttributes.tacomaFitNotes: Large front-to-back footprint when reclined (~29 in reported), which is challenging in a Tacoma's shallow rear seat (~23 in depth with bases extended, Tacoma4G forum). The lie-flat/extended-leg recline trades small-vehicle fit for comfort — weaker Tacoma fit than the compact Clek Liing. No Tacoma-specific fitment doc found; see CSFTL Cloud G Lux review for shell/recline detail.

notes: FLAG (b) RESOLVED: the Cloud G does NOT share the Cloud Q's BOB adapter. Both the BOB Wayfinder and the Alterrain/Alterrain Pro fitment lists name the Cybex *Cloud Q* (and Aton series) — NOT the Cloud G/Cloud G Lux. So the seed stub is WRONG: it currently has fitsWayfinder=true and fitsAlterrain=true; both should flip to FALSE for the Cloud G Lux. IMPORTANT for integration: the Cloud G Lux is being discontinued/phased out in favor of the Cloud G Pro — Cybex DTC, Strolleria, and ANB Baby all show it unavailable; only Bambi Baby still shows it in stock at $499.95 (the consistent street price/MSRP). Carrier weight ~11 lb (Cybex spec page lists 12 lb for the carrier). seed stub price 550 is high vs. the $499.95 street price.
